scope.description: Owner-alive case: one replica owns instance (0,0), admitted one client operation for it, and receives one legal single-NONE Commit for that instance.
assumptions: the owner's record still holds its leader bookkeeping and the admitted proposal
the commit is well formed for that instance
excluded: the restarted-owner case, where the record has no bookkeeping (claim C4 covers the crash there)
the client library's own retry behaviour
execution of the re-proposed operation and its reply

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: harness-only scaffolding: two Replica values are constructed in-package with buffer peer writers; the handlers are unmodified and messages travel through the real codec
the client's reply writer is a harness buffer, so the observation is the bytes the implementation wrote

plan_uncertainties: the harness supplies the client's reply writer, so it observes the bytes the implementation wrote rather than a socket
one operation and one re-proposal round are exercised
grounding_unresolved: the restarted-owner case is a separate claim
the client's own retry behaviour is outside this check
the peer is a second harness replica rather than a separately configured participant
